enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Remain still. Breathe. Occasionally turn over. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Continue sleeping.

Wake up. Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Open bathroom door. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Adjust shower temperature. Step into shower. Wet hair and body. Pick up soap. Lather. Scrub body. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry hair and body. Wipe mirror. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, milk, bread. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cupboard. Take out bowl, plate. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Pour egg mixture into pan. Cook eggs. Flip eggs. Turn off induction cooker. Place eggs on plate. Toast bread in toaster. Spread butter on toast. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place plate in dishwasher. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Select shirt. Select pants. Take off sleepwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Look in mirror. Comb hair. Pick up bag. Check phone. Put phone in pocket. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card on reader. Find seat. Sit down. Look at phone. Listen to music. Bus stops. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Greet receptionist. Walk to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a Health Care Professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter office. Turn on computer. Log in. Check emails. Attend morning meeting. Take notes. Examine patient. Record patient information. Use stethoscope. Wash hands. Prescribe medication. Consult with colleague. Eat lunch. Attend afternoon meeting. Update patient records. Turn off computer. Leave office.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look at phone. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter house.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables, meat. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cupboard. Take out pot, pan. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pot on cooker. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off cooker. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place in dishwasher. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing, watching TV or using computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Pick up computer. Open laptop. Check social media. Type message. Watch video. Put down computer. Pick up remote. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down, using phone or computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Scroll through apps. Type message. Watch video. Put down phone. Pick up computer. Open laptop. Browse internet. Watch movie. Put down computer. Lie down. Close eyes. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Night routine, brushing teeth and washing
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Apply moisturizer. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.
Walk to bedroom. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Sleep.
